overestimate_radius_2.description: Non-exact mass is split equally between one- and two-cell overestimation.

symmetric_radius_1.description: Non-exact mass is split equally between adjacent lower and higher cost cells.

symmetric_radius_2.description: Non-exact mass is split equally across one- and two-cell errors in either direction.

underestimate_radius_2.description: Non-exact mass is split equally between one- and two-cell underestimation.

limitations: The multinomial concentration bound is distribution-free and conservative; exact multinomial confidence regions can require fewer samples.
Policy identity is uncertifiable at zero-radius prevalence boundaries even when several policies have identical regression.
Infinite radius means no tested competitor has lower regression at any cost prevalence, not that every untested policy is dominated.
The 10% prevalence simplex and E88 sensitivity kernels are not calibrated deployment distributions.
The audit reuses compact E83 path summaries and is not new GPU evidence.
model: Certify the E89 prevalence-selected policy from a finite multinomial sample. The stability radius is the exact minimum L1 distance from the true six-cell prevalence to a competitor regression boundary.
